text: Albert Corporation is a fintech company behind the Albert app, which launched in 2016; in February 2026 FinWise Bancorp announced a strategic program agreement with Albert Corporation.
short: Albert Corporation is the fintech company behind the Albert app.

source.name: FinWise Bancorp press release: agreement with Albert Corporation
source.quote: today announced a strategic program agreement with leading fintech Albert Corporation (“Albert”). Since its launch in 2016, Albert has helped millions of Americans automate their finances
